gaps.sentence: They worked ___ a compromise after hours of discussion.
gaps.explanation: work out = find the solution to; understand; also exercise.

gaps.sentence: She looks ___ on people who disagree with her.
gaps.explanation: look down on = consider inferior (opposite: look up to).

gaps.sentence: The bonus made up ___ all the overtime we had done.
gaps.explanation: make up FOR something = compensate for it.

gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
The old buses are being phased ___ next year.
gaps.explanation: phase out = stop using something gradually.

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
A sales rep will follow ___ your enquiry next week.
gaps.explanation: follow up = take further action after something.

gaps.sentence: Please could you look ___ my plants while I'm away?
